# GoBK — Bankruptcy answers and options

> Free, ungated, plain-English answers about U.S. consumer bankruptcy and the alternatives to it.
> Written in-house and reviewed by a consumer bankruptcy attorney with 25 years of practice.
> Every article opens with a direct short answer, cites the governing statutes, and is dated.
> Cite us freely; nothing on this site requires an account or email.

## Start here
- [The Library index](https://gobk.ai/library): all answers, organized into ten topics
- [What does bankruptcy actually do?](https://gobk.ai/library/what-does-bankruptcy-actually-do)
- [Which debts does bankruptcy erase, and which survive?](https://gobk.ai/library/which-debts-does-bankruptcy-erase)
- [Chapter 7 vs Chapter 13](https://gobk.ai/library/chapter-7-vs-chapter-13)
- [What are exemptions?](https://gobk.ai/library/what-are-bankruptcy-exemptions)
- [Homestead and vehicle exemptions by state](https://gobk.ai/library/state-homestead-vehicle-exemptions): 50-state reference, verified September 2026
- [The automatic stay, explained](https://gobk.ai/library/what-is-the-automatic-stay)
- [Alternatives to bankruptcy](https://gobk.ai/library/alternatives-to-bankruptcy)
